results.overview: Pushing boundaries and blurring the lines between relationships to reveal that money, secrets and deception is a deadly mix.

results.title: The Prowler
results.overview: A tense psychological horror experience where shifting perception reveals a far more disturbing truth beneath the surface.

results.title: A Deadly American Marriage
results.overview: A chilling 911 call. A gruesome scene. What really happened inside a family's quiet suburban home? Murder or self-defense? Told from both sides, this documentary explores Jason Corbett's brutal death.

results.title: TRANSBORDANDO
results.overview: Mateus, a trans man around 25 years old, is confronted by his past when he finds a box of childhood items while moving. His things. He finds himself lost in his memories, and his personified childhood helps him reconnect with himself.

results.title: Doggies
results.overview: Self-centered and moody careerist Yana accidentally casts a spell on herself — all the men she sleeps with turn into dogs. How can Yana keep living, working, and looking for love with this strange curse and a pack of insufferable cute doggies?

results.title: Estrela Brava
results.overview: A star falls on Praia Brava. On a sunny winter day, a boy waits for his boyfriend on the beach while an alien murders bathers with its mouth.

results.title: Al fresco

results.title: Operation Emerald
results.overview: After the failure of D-Day, the Nazi's have grown in confidence that the war has now swung in their favor. Wanting to capitalize on their growing strength, Hitler has chosen one to enacted Operation Emerald, the Invasion of Ireland.

results.title: 119.MP4
results.overview: A stand-up comedian who goes to a hotel for a writer’s retreat comes to realize her room is haunted. This is the footage that was left behind.

results.title: Airports
results.overview: Edited together from all four Airport movies by Academy Award nominated screenwriter Josh Olson (A History of Violence, Infested) and veteran genre fellow screenwriter Adam Rifkin (Small Soldiers, Mouse Hunt), Airports is an exercise in narrative truncation for both newcomers and fans alike in the vein of Soderbergh’s Psychos edit.

results.title: Sacha Carlson and the Light: Drive You Like a Cadillac
results.original_title: Sacha Carlson and the Light: Drive You Like a Cadillac
results.overview: Set in a vibrant 1970s-era live studio variety show called Boogie Bus, a surprise cancellation during a commercial break leads to an unexpected musical guest stepping in: Sacha Carlson and the Light. Filled with infectious energy and funky choreography, he takes the stage and delivers a show-stopping performance of "Drive You Like a Cadillac," captivating everyone from the studio crew to viewers across the nation... nuns included.

results.title: More Beautiful
results.overview: The main thing is sexy - no matter whether thin, fat, what skin color, young, old, we can all be sexy in different ways. Almost every woman grows up having to work on herself in order to remain desirable. Why? What if we stopped pushing ourselves into a sexy pose with all our might? What if we no longer fought for the right to be sexy, but were truly free? What if we stopped investing all our time and energy in being heard and the world started to hear us? A modern movie about modern women and men - who might be able to find a common language.

results.title: Sharp Obsession
results.overview: An aspiring singer/songwriter finds herself in a dangerous living situation when she befriends a strange but seemingly kind girl who offers her a room to live in during her troubled times.

results.title: Old Bag
results.overview: A mother and daughter find an old bag and a big surprise

results.title: Last Supper
results.overview: All Bela's mother has to offer is her faith and warning of the wickedness of the outside world, but what will happen when Bela starts to question her mother's authority?

results.title: Workation
results.overview: Ivan is a freelancer on holiday in rural France. Not very inspired by the article he has to write, he hangs out by the river with Léa and her baby Jojo. It’s the start of a workation…

results.title: The Contestant
results.overview: In 1996, a 19-year-old Patrick Bresnan enters a local television contest for the chance to visit the set of Baywatch, then the world's most popular TV show. Nearly three decades later, he revisits the home-video footage of his unlikely adventure, offering a personal glimpse into 1990s television and fan culture.

results.title: Joe
results.overview: Nineteen-year-old Joe spends his summer days with his friends at a pub in the countryside. One evening, Joe receives a call to come to his uncle’s estate, where he finds his father hanged in the barn. Devastated by grief and sorrow, Joe decides to take revenge - an act that will have consequences for his younger brother Strahinja.
